About Summer Joyful, silly, loving, and unforgettable. Summer was born in August 2014 and brought constant joy, silliness, and positivity to our family. She loved all things Disney—especially Pixar's Monsters, Inc.—and took excellent care of her three dogs: Daisy, Buzz, and Lilly. Music, sparkly manicures, Mickey Mouse, and Doc McStuffins were always close by. In March 2015, at just seven months old, doctors discovered a 10 cm mass in her liver. What was initially thought to be hepatoblastoma was later identified as a rare Malignant Rhabdoid Tumor. For more than a year and a half, Summer faced continuous, high-intensity treatment, including extensive surgeries, a stem cell transplant, and radiation. Summer's life was far too short. Her impact was not. Summer's joy remains at the heart of everything Team Summer Strong does. The Hero Fund Turning an unimaginable loss into meaningful progress. Shortly after Summer's diagnosis, our family and friends became involved with Alex's Lemonade Stand Foundation to make lemonade out of an unimaginable situation. Today, Team Summer Strong is a nationwide community represented at lemonade stands, school fundraisers, races, and our annual golf outing. Every fundraiser helps move childhood cancer research forward. A child should never have to wait for a lifesaving clinical trial. Support the Hero Fund 10th Annual Golf Outing Thank you for showing up for Summer. The 10th Annual Summer Strong Golf Outing was held on July 14, 2026, at Pebble Creek Golf Club. We are grateful to every golfer, sponsor, volunteer, donor, and friend who helped carry Summer's legacy forward. The outing may be over, but the need for better treatments is not.
